result.summary: Found 1 major issue: overlapping delivery time and delivery fee text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing makes the metadata unreadable.

issues.description: The delivery time text and the delivery fee/pricing text overlap in the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine on separate lines or in a properly spaced single line so the labels do not collide.
